basic_info.description: This well-maintained Central Sunset single-family home harmoniously combines its original charm with modern design and timeless comfort. The main level features 2 bedrooms with ocean views overlooking the backyard and 1.5 baths. It offers a spacious living room with a fireplace, a large formal dining room, and a bright eat-in kitchen illuminated by natural light from numerous windows. The home has been freshly painted throughout with new lighting fixtures, making it move-in ready, and boasts beautiful hardwood floors.    The unwarranted lower level comprises a large 1 bedroom/1 full bath and a small office. Both levels provide internal access to the expansive backyard, ideal for outdoor entertainment or gardening. A separate side entrance allows direct access to the downstairs and backyard. The property also includes a 2-car garage , space for motorcycles, and an additional driveway parking space.  It features high ceilings and ample space for an ADU, presenting exciting potential for expansion. The washer and dryer are conveniently located behind the kitchen on the main level, and the home is equipped with a central heating system. This vibrant location is close to numerous shops, restaurants, Golden Gate Park, and UCSF. Do not miss this fantastic opportunity!
